Package org.webharvest.definition

Interface ConfigSource

  • All Superinterfaces:
    HasReader
    All Known Implementing Classes:
    AbstractConfigSource, BufferConfigSource, FileConfigSource, URLConfigSource
    public interface ConfigSource
extends HasReader
    Represents source of XML configuration object. The configuration can be loaded from different sources like database, remote web server or just plain old file system.
    Since:
    2.1.0-SNAPSHOT
    Version:
    %I%, %G%
    Author:
    Robert Bala

    • Method Detail

      • getLocation

        ConfigSource.Location getLocation()
        Gets the reference to physical location of configuration. (eg. URL or file path).
        Returns:
        location of configuration.

      • include

        ConfigSource include​(ConfigSource.Location location)
              throws IOException
        Includes specified ConfigSource.Location from current configuration if possible. Included configuration is not merged but instead returned as a reference to new ConfigSource. Inclusion is smart enough to decide if the current configuration source points to a file system or remote web server location to determine the base for always contextual location that has been specified to include.
        Parameters:
        location - reference to ConfigSource.Location to include.
        Returns:
        Included instance of ConfigSource or throws IllegalStateException in case of unrecognized ConfigSource.Location type.
        Throws:
        IOException - In case of any problems with instantiation of included ConfigSource
